auth.signUpSubtitle: It takes less than a minute.
auth.setupSubtitle: You are the first person here, so you will be the instance administrator.
auth.joinSubtitle: Create an account to accept the invitation.
auth.name: Full name
auth.signUpClosedBody: Ask an administrator of your organization to invite you. The invitation email or link lets you create your account.

invite.title: You are invited to {{org}}
invite.body: You have been invited to join {{org}} as {{role}}.
invite.wrongAccountTitle: This invitation is for another account
invite.wrongAccountBody: It was sent to {{invited}}, but you are signed in as {{current}}.
invite.expiredBody: Invitation links are valid for 7 days. Ask an admin of {{org}} to send you a new one.
invite.acceptedBody: If it was you, open your organizations to continue.
invite.revokedBody: Ask an admin of {{org}} for a new invitation.
invite.notFoundBody: The link may be incomplete. Copy it again from the message you received.

onboarding.orgBody: Organizations hold your applications, test cases and team. You can create more later.
onboarding.appBody: An application is a product or system you test, such as a web shop or an API.
onboarding.keyHint: Prefixes item IDs, like {{example}}. It cannot be changed later.
onboarding.inviteBody: Testing is a team sport. Invite people now or later from organization settings.

apps.title: Applications
apps.subtitle: Products and systems your team tests.
apps.emptyAdminBody: Applications group test cases, scenarios and runs for a product or system.
apps.emptyMemberBody: You do not have access to any application in this organization. Ask an admin to give you access.
apps.createBody: You can rename it later; the key is permanent.

app.archivedBanner: This application is archived and read-only.
app.comingSoonBody: This is where {{app}}'s test cases, scenarios and runs will live. For now you can manage who has access in settings.

orgSettings.title: Organization settings
